import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { ExportImportDataService, UserRoleProfile, UserRole } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-role-management', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `
Admin Administration Vault

All Users Management & Access Security Matrix

Manage system access across all 3 user roles: Admin, Investigating Officer, and Operator.

👑 Admin Role (Executive Board)

Full system control, manage all users, LC approvals, and executive financial reports.

Active Accounts: {{ getCountByRole('Admin') }}
🔍 Investigating Officer Role

Customs audit, compliance certificates inspection, duty payment clearance, and landed cost audit.

Active Accounts: {{ getCountByRole('Investigating Officer') }}
🏭 Operator Role

Daily warehouse bin management, damaged quantity logging, import PO entry, and vessel logistics.

Active Accounts: {{ getCountByRole('Operator') }}

Registered Staff Directory

Total Users: {{ dataService.users().length }}
@for (user of dataService.users(); track user.id) { }
User ID Staff Name & Avatar Corporate Email User Role Assigned Department Assigned Permissions Action
{{ user.id }}
{{ user.name }}
{{ user.email }} {{ user.role }} {{ user.department }}
@for (perm of user.permissions; track perm) { {{ perm }} }
@if (showAddUserModal()) {

Register New Staff User

}
` }) export class RoleManagementComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); showAddUserModal = signal(false); newName = ''; newEmail = ''; newRole: UserRole = 'Operator'; newDept = ''; getCountByRole(role: UserRole): number { return this.dataService.users().filter(u => u.role === role).length; } getRoleBadgeClass(role: UserRole): string { if (role === 'Admin') return 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold border border-emerald-200'; if (role === 'Investigating Officer') return 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold border border-blue-200'; return 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold border border-amber-200'; } submitNewUser() { if (!this.newName || !this.newEmail) return; const newUser: UserRoleProfile = { id: `USR-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`, name: this.newName, email: this.newEmail, role: this.newRole, avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=150&q=80', department: this.newDept || 'Keya Group Operations', permissions: [this.newRole.toUpperCase()] }; this.dataService.users.update(list => [...list, newUser]); this.showAddUserModal.set(false); this.newName = ''; this.newEmail = ''; } editUserPermissions(user: UserRoleProfile) { alert(`Admin Vault: Managing Security Permissions for ${user.name} (${user.role}).`); } }
